 Add to Cart Description
 MAXIMUM PERFORMANCE MINERAL SUNSCREEN: Broad Spectrum SPF 50 protection using non-nano uncoated Zinc Oxide to shield against UVA & UVB rays, clinically tested safe for sensitive skin, suitable sunblock for face, body, and heavy outdoor activity
 CLEAN & 98% ORGANIC INGREDIENTS: Formulated with just 4 simple ingredients: mineral zinc oxide, organic sunflower oil, organic beeswax, & sunflower vitamin E, making it NSF Certified Organic, non-GMO, gluten-free, and chemical-free
 SWEAT & WATER RESISTANT: Designed for active lifestyles, this sport mineral sunscreen stays on for 80 minutes during swimming, surfing, and skiing; rubs in clear with no white cast, providing heavy-duty protection that won't sting your eyes or clog pores
 REEF SAFE & TRAVEL FRIENDLY: The first formula to achieve Protect Land + Sea Certification; fully compliant with Hawaii and Mexico reef-safe sunscreen laws, containing no oxybenzone or octinoxate
 SUSTAINABLE & ETHICAL SKINCARE: 100% cruelty-free (Leaping Bunny Certified) & packaged in a recylable tin; made in the USA by a women-owned family business using 100% solar power, making it a guilt-free, plastic-free choice for conscious consumers
